description.value:
You touch an unenhanced structure or object not worn or carried by anyone but you, and it cracks or tears apart across an area up to 1 foot in any dimension; cast this way, the power takes 1 minute to complete.

Alternatively, you can touch a droid or construct and make a melee tech attack against it, dealing 1d6 energy damage on a hit; cast this way, the power takes only 1 action.

This power's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
